:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE

:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT
I really, really don't want to touch meta-resolutions (how the GA operates) with a barge pole under the current mod legality scheme given they already jumped on an opportunity to screw up committees
So while I may be against this on principle, I'd also oppose a replacement

Going after compliance, funding, etc. and constructing a meta-res scheme clearly distinct from "normal" resolutions is a little architecture project I've been thinking about for a while, and this repeal would certainly feed into that (eventually), but the timing's just bad bad bad

Note that I'm not talking about the actual merits of this repeal because there aren't any. All the target does is fact-finding. You repeal this kind of stuff for doctrinal reasons, not writing flaws (even admin compliance act, the logical next target, would fall under that despite having issues)
Doctrinal repeals are fine, but again, I'd rather this stuff be frozen in amber until Sedge et al wander off again

My most radical GA take might be that meta-resolutions about funding and such shouldn't need to exist. The GA doesn't make any sense unless you assume there's some black box handling things like funding, committee staffing, and compliance
But I certainly don't trust the current "team" with that lol
